name: Coast Performance Horses
description: Renova's primary scope on this property was replacing roughly 90 rotten support posts with new pressure-treated posts — structural remediation that kept a working equestrian facility safe without shutting it down. The project also included rebuilding the arena's interior kick wall, plus a new riding arena and barn with a standing-seam metal roof and three framed lantern-roof cupolas built on-site and craned into place.
scope: Post replacement (~90 posts), kick wall reconstruction, structural framing, lantern-roof cupolas, cladding, doors, interior finishing
